Mean profile plot (mean +/- CI over time by group)

Source: R/plot_mean_profile.R
plot_mean_profile.Rd

Computes the mean and confidence interval of one or more proteins at each level of an x-axis variable (e.g. time point), separately for each group, and plots points with error bars connected by lines. This is the classic "mean NPX trajectory" plot for longitudinal group comparisons.

Usage

plot_mean_profile(
  data,
  assay,
  x = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  lod_col = NULL,
  show_lod = FALSE,
  ci_level = 0.95,
  error_bar_type = "ci",
  add_signif = FALSE,
  test = "wilcox.test",
  paired = FALSE,
  subject_id = NULL,
  comparisons = NULL,
  compare_groups = FALSE,
  show_p_value = FALSE,
  show_significant = FALSE,
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  bracket_nudge_y = NULL,
  step_increase = 0.12,
  dodge_width = 0.2,
  palette = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format, or an OlinkExperiment.

assay

Name(s) of the protein/assay(s) to plot (must match values in `assay_col`). When multiple assays are supplied, the plot is faceted by assay.

x

Name of the x-axis variable (e.g. "Timepoint"). If NULL, auto-detected from common time/visit columns.

group

Optional column name for the grouping variable (colored lines). If NULL, no grouping is used.

assay_col

Name of the assay column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

lod_col

Optional column name holding an LOD value; draws a dashed LOD reference line when supplied.

show_lod

Logical; if `TRUE`, auto-detects the LOD column (or `lod(oe)`) and draws a dashed LOD reference line (default `FALSE`).

ci_level

Confidence level for the error bars (default 0.95).

error_bar_type

Either "ci" (confidence interval of the mean, default) or "se" (standard error).

add_signif

Logical; annotate between-group p-values at each x level using `ggpubr::stat_compare_means()` (requires `ggpubr`, default FALSE).

test

Statistical test for significance annotations: "wilcox.test" (default) or "t.test".

paired

Logical; whether to perform paired statistical tests (default `FALSE`).

subject_id

Optional subject ID column name used to align paired samples.

comparisons

A list of length-2 vectors specifying pairwise comparisons between x levels (e.g. timepoints). If `NULL` and `show_p_value`/`show_significant` is used, every pair of x levels is compared.

compare_groups

Logical; when `TRUE` and `group` is supplied, compare `group` levels within each `x` level rather than pooling across groups (default `FALSE`).

show_p_value

Logical; annotate numeric p-values for each pairwise comparison. Requires `ggpubr` (default FALSE).

show_significant

Logical; annotate significance stars (*, **, ***) for each pairwise comparison. Requires `ggpubr` (default FALSE).

p_cutoff

Significance threshold: when `show_significant = TRUE`, only comparisons with p < `p_cutoff` are drawn (default 0.05). Set to `NULL` to show every comparison.

bracket_nudge_y

Numeric vertical offset for the comparison brackets so they are raised above the data. If `NULL` (default), ~10 is used automatically.

step_increase

Fraction of the plot height between stacked brackets (default 0.12).

dodge_width

Horizontal offset between groups at the same x (default 0.2).

palette

Optional color palette for groups.

title

Plot title. If NULL, uses the assay name (or NULL when faceted).

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_errorbar()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_mean_profile(
  probc, assay = "IL6", x = "Timepoint", group = "Project"
)
} # }
